# Weekly Intelligence Briefing

```sql briefings
select
    week_start,
    briefing_text,
    model_used,
    generated_at
from snowflake.mart_weekly_briefing
order by generated_at desc
limit 10
```

```sql latest_briefing
select
    week_start,
    briefing_text,
    model_used,
    generated_at
from snowflake.mart_weekly_briefing
order by generated_at desc
limit 1
```

## Latest Briefing

*Generated by {latest_briefing[0].model_used} · Week of {latest_briefing[0].week_start}*

{latest_briefing[0].briefing_text}
